note: Indicative values. Only the anchors listed under 'anchors' were found in sources; everything else is a placeholder pending sign-off.

anchors.paper: EPA WARM v16: corrugated containers, net recycling emissions (3.14) MTCO2E per short ton = 3.46 kg CO2e per kg. Mixed paper is lower, so 3.0 is used.
anchors.metal: EPA WARM (older snapshot): aluminum cans recycling -9.11 MTCO2E per short ton = 10 kg CO2e per kg; steel is far lower. 4.0 is a blended placeholder.
anchors.plastic: WARM models recycling only for HDPE and PET; v16 value not retrieved. 1.5 is a placeholder.
anchors.glass: WARM v16 glass chapter exists; value not retrieved. 0.3 is a placeholder.
anchors.ewaste: No WARM-equivalent retrieved for mixed e-waste. 2.0 is a placeholder.
